facets.description: Blacklist check in addGuests.handler (lines 70-78): guest emails are not lowercased while blacklist entries are, so mixed-case blacklisted addresses get through
Existing-attendee check in addGuests.handler (line 76) is case-sensitive, so an existing attendee can be added again with different casing
No server-side dedupe of the input guests array; uniqueness is only enforced on the client
No protection against concurrent requests inserting the same guest (needs a transaction or unique constraint with skipDuplicates)
